newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-BTPs looking for further losses, 128.57 key.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-BTPs looking for further losses, 128.57 key.

text.p: June BTP futures traded on LIFFE could suffer further losses on Wednesday and the market initially faces a key test at 128.57, technical analysts said.
RSI and stochastics on hourly charts were signalling oversold, but analysts could still not rule out further slides.

One analyst at an Italian bank here said 128.57 was a 50 percent retracement of the move from 125.80 on April 25 to 131.40 on May 21. Failing to hold 128.57, BTPs would receive moderate support at 128.40 and further down a 61.8 percent retracement of 128.00 would come into force.
By 0735 GMT June BTPs traded 18 basis points down at 128.95.
"If 128.57 holds we may receive a positive trend signal pointing to 129.50," said the analyst at the Italian bank.
The hourly charts showed a temporary interruption in the downward trend.
"I don't think the market can lose another point today," he said. But a key reversal, or a crossing of nearby moving averages was needed to confirm a possible trend change, he said.
June BTPs posted a nervous session on Wednesday, moving from a high of 130.32 to a close of 129.13, slashing technical indicators and oscillators to a sell.
Analysts at Chase in London were also bearish on BTPs.

"A break below here (128.90) will extend the correction from the 131.38 high recorded last week, targeting initial support at 128.67 and then major up trendline support (currently intervening at 128.48) ahead of the 38.2 pct retracement level from the 123.60 March low which intervenes at 128.41," Chase analysts said in a reseach note.
For a medium term positive outlook 128.48 needed to hold.

Near term down trendline resistance was put at 130.10, but a break above 130.32 was required to put a corrective bottom in place, it said. By 0845 GMT, the June Eurolira future traded on LIFFE was one basis point up at 93.14.
